recipes.title: Infernal Furnace
notes: Follow the 3 × 3 × 3 diagram in the Thaumonomicon. The top center is empty; the middle center contains lava and the middle front has iron bars.
After completing the research, use a casting wand on the structure’s obsidian, nether brick, or iron bars. Activation spends 100 base vis before wand discounts.
recipes.power: 100 base vis from the wand before discounts

outputs: Smelted items and possible bonus materials

recipeNote: Follow the Thaumonomicon construction diagram after research.
